findings.title: SQL injection vulnerability in user name search
findings.explanation: The function builds the SQL query by directly interpolating the `name` parameter into the query string using an f-string. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL code via the `name` argument, leading to potential data leakage or modification.

evidence.quote: query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'"

limitations: No supporting code or tests were provided, so we cannot assess how this function is used or whether any input sanitization is applied elsewhere.
missing_inputs: No supporting code was provided; only the diff is visible.
